_comments: A-US5(i) / golive #161 — THE NIGHTLY ORDER + PAYMENT POST. One job → Accounting.BuildJournalEntryBatches
with AutoPost, so it builds AND dispatches in one run rather than parking a batch in Pending.
· CronExpression `0 0 1 * * *` — SIX fields, seconds first: 01:00:00 UTC every day. After
midnight (the story's requirement) and an hour ahead of the 02:00 ERP master-data sync, so
the chart of accounts a post resolves against is the one the previous day's sync left.
· CutoffMode PriorDay — resolved in TypeScript at run time, NOT in SQL. Scheduled-job params
are Static or SQL-Statement only, and the driver's SQL path returns a row set and swallows
errors as null; a null cutoff means NO date clause, which would post the current day's
entries and fail the acceptance criteria outright. PriorDay resolves to yesterday midnight
UTC, which pendingCandidateFilter turns into `EffectiveDate < today` — the prior day is
included, the run date is excluded, exactly as the story asks.
· EntryTypeCodes is the AUTO-POST POLICY and it is an INCLUDE-LIST, deliberately. A blacklist
would silently auto-post any JournalEntryType added later; a financial control defaults the
other way, so a new type waits for CFO approval until an admin names it here. Refund is in
the list because PaymentJournalEntryFactory writes it as the mirror of a PaymentReceipt —
it is a Payment JE. Everything else (Manual, Adjustment, Reversal, FXRevaluation, …) stays
on the attended path (A-US7). This row is the whole policy surface: admins edit it here.
· ConcurrencyMode Skip — an overlapping run would race the first one for the same Pending
entries. MissedRunPolicy RunOnce, not RunAll: the selection is a relative date window, so
catching up ten missed nights ten times over would just re-run the same widened sweep.
· No CFO approval Task is raised (the scheduled-posting waiver in #161). ApprovedByUserID is
still stamped — with the scheduler's context user, the seeded MJ System user. The waiver
removes the approval step, not the audit trail.
· NotifyOnFailure: a batch whose ERP dispatch fails lands Failed with the cause in
ErrorMessage and the run reports DISPATCH_FAILED, so this notification is the trigger for
human triage. OwnerUserID / NotifyUserID stay NULL — naming a person here would seed one
deployment's staff into another's database.
· Hosts disable this row rather than deleting it.

fields.Name: Accounting — Post Order & Payment journal entries (nightly)
fields.Description: Builds and dispatches a single-company batch of the Pending Order and Payment journal entries dated before the run date, for every company with candidates. Unattended: no CFO approval Task, per the scheduled-posting waiver. Which entry types may post unattended is the EntryTypeCodes include-list on this job.
